messages.author: 6923163bd88a86ad
messages.subject: Positive marginal log-likelihood
parts:
Dear all,

I am confused by positive values for marginal log-likelihood produced by some models. Am I wrong to assume these correspond to 0-1 values of likelihood so the log-likelihood should be negative? INLA Gitbook by Virgilio Gómez-Rubio gives examples of models with positive marginal log-likelihood, e.g. in 3.3.10 Seasonal random effects

I noticed models with positive log-likelihood give a negative DIC. Can DIC still be used the same way to compare the models with opposite DIC signs? 

Please forgive me these basic questions but I'm new to INLA.

Kind regards,
Prez

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Positive marginal log-likelihood
parts:
Its log marginal likelihood, yes.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Positive marginal log-likelihood
parts:
The log-likelihood can be positive for continuous outcomes; the 3.3.10 example has a Gaussian conditional distribution as the observation likelihood.

Finn
